title: Accept instruction halts with acceptance
statement: Let $P$ be a Word RAM program and $c$ a configuration. If the instruction at the program counter of $c$, using rejection as the default instruction when the counter is out of range, is accept, then one step of $P$ from $c$ returns the acceptance result.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at $c$'s program counter, with reject as the out-of-range default, is accept
